descriptionHtml:
Raincoat is hiring a Senior Data Infrastructure Engineer to lead our lakehouse platform. We are looking for someone who has owned distributed data systems in production and who can mentor a small platform team.

  • Design the data platform roadmap for the next two years.
  • Operate the real-time ingestion pipeline feeding our analytics warehouse.
  • Set SLIs and run blameless incident reviews.
additional: We value written-first communication and async work across time zones.
